body:
## What this trip is

Abu Simbel is a long drive from Aswan, so visitors normally reach it on an organised day trip that starts before dawn. This listing is a guided version: a small group of up to 12 travellers, an English-speaking guide, and transport by car, departing from and returning to Aswan.

## The shape of the day

The listing gives the whole trip as nine hours, from 04:00 to 13:00. Pick-up from your hotel in Aswan is free and happens between 04:00 and 04:30. The operator confirms your exact pick-up time in advance, and you enter your hotel name and address when you check out so they know where to find you. The itinerary shows about eight hours for the Abu Simbel stop itself, which is guided. You are dropped back at any address you choose, around 12:30 to 13:00, and the listing says to contact your driver for the drop-off.

Because pick-up is so early, arrange your wake-up and your hotel's door or reception in advance. Latecomers and no-shows are not refunded.

## Check what is covered before you pay

This is the part to read slowly. The inclusions on the listing name a live English-speaking guide and transport by car, and also mention meals and admission without saying which of these are covered. The Abu Simbel stop is marked **pay on site**. In practice that means you should find out, before booking and before the day, whether the temple entrance fee is part of the price you pay on Klook or is something you pay yourself at the site, and whether any meal is provided. If the listing does not answer it, message the operator or Klook support first and keep their reply.

## Group size

The group is listed as small, from 1 to 12 people. That is smaller than the large coach groups some other trips use, but it is still a shared tour with other travellers rather than a private one. The listing's "you might also like" section shows separate private-tour options if exclusivity matters to you.

## Cancellation

Cancellation is free up to 48 hours before the activity date, in Egypt's local time. If the operator cancels because of unforeseen events or extreme weather, the listing says you can request a full refund. Once you have joined an activity, visited an attraction or used a ticket, refunds cannot be issued, and approval of reschedules, amendments or refunds depends on availability.

## Who runs it

The trip is operated by Top Tours In Egypt and sold through Klook.

## Practical tips

- Confirm your pick-up time and place the evening before.
- Bring water, sun protection and whatever you need for a very early start in a hot climate.
- Carry local currency in case admission or other costs are paid on site.
